focuses.desc:
The Soviet Union has surrendered. From Tiflis, Reichskommissar Arno Schickedanz - Rosenberg's old friend from Riga - rules fourteen states from the Kuban to the Caspian: the Cossack steppe, the Kalmyk plain, the mountain peoples of the North Caucasus, and Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan beyond the range. And under it all: the oil of Baku, Grozny and Maikop.

THE TREE (draft): Reichskommissariat Kaukasien (RKK), about 5 years of focuses (35-70 days), from its creation to the German civil war.

THE ONE RK THAT NEVER BREAKS (user, 2026-11-24): unlike Moskowien, Ukraine and Ostland, Kaukasien NEVER goes through a civil war or a collapse-rising - not in the Moskowien civil war, not when Moscow or Leningrad falls, not when it capitulates. It does have partisans, all the time.

14 STATES:
- Cossack and steppe land: Krasnodar (234, Kuban), Stavropol (235), Volgodonsk (238), Kalmykia (237), Astrakhan (236), Sochi (233).
- The North Caucasus mountains: Kabardino-Balkaria (827), North Ossetia (828), Chechnya-Ingushetia (821, Grozny oil), Dagestan (232).
- Transcaucasia: Georgia (231, capital Tiflis), Abkhazia (826), Armenia (230), Azerbaijan (229, Baku: 70 oil).

CORING: the Cossack and Kalmyk steppe - Krasnodar, Stavropol, Volgodonsk (the Cossack Hosts) and Kalmykia - through the Cossack and Kalmyk branches. And ONE Transcaucasian nation, through The Capital Question (user, 2026-11-24): Georgia (231), Armenia (230) OR Azerbaijan (229). However many rights Kaukasien gives its peoples - more than Moskowien ever does - the old ethnic hatreds mean it can only favour one. The choice is where the final capital goes: Tiflis, Yerevan or Baku. The chosen nation is cored and content; the other two get 'Ethnic Tension'. Never cored: the mountains.

THE MOUNTAIN PARTISANS (to build) - Moskowien's raid countdown (wif_rkm.20), from day one, but aimed at the OIL: each raid hits a mountain or Transcaucasian state, and in the oil states it blows up a refinery or cuts oil output for 90 days (add_resource with days). Base 150 days - rarer than Ukraine (120), because most of Kaukasien's peoples can be bought. The Chase the Terrorists decisions are copied (Caucasian partisans). The SME can arm them.

THE OIL: Germany's Facade Economy already gets The Oil of the Caucasus while RKK is a subject. RKK can also Send Extra Oil to the Reich (like Ukraine's Extra Grain): Germany's consumer goods rise more slowly for 180 days; Kaukasien pays in stability and the next raid comes sooner.

Effect: Arno Schickedanz rules from Tiflis. Spirits: The Oil Reichskommissariat (+20% local resources, -10% stability) and A Mosaic of Peoples (+10% compliance growth, -10% political power).
focuses.name: Reichskommissariat Kaukasien

focuses.desc:
Arno Schickedanz moves into the Viceroy's Palace on Rustaveli Avenue, with plans for a palace of his own that Berlin has not paid for.

Effect: +50 political power.
focuses.name: Schickedanz in Tiflis

focuses.desc:
Rosenberg always meant the Caucasus to be ruled differently from the Ukraine: a 'federation' of peoples, each set against Moscow, all bound to Berlin.

Effect: +5% stability. Unlocks the choice of rule.
focuses.name: Rosenberg's Caucasus

focuses.desc:
National committees for the Georgians, Armenians, Azerbaijanis and the North Caucasian peoples: flags, schools, a token parliament - and no army of their own.

Effect: spirit 'The Federation': +15% compliance growth, +10% stability, -10% local resources. Raids 20 days later for good.
focuses.name: The Caucasian Federation

focuses.desc:
Goring's Four-Year Plan men win the argument in Berlin: the Caucasus is a petrol station with a population problem.

Effect: spirit 'The Oil Colony': +25% local resources, -10% stability, -10% compliance growth. Raids 20 days sooner for good.
focuses.name: The Oil Colony

focuses.desc:
Exiles from Paris, Berlin and Istanbul come home to sit on committees that advise the Reichskommissar.

Effect: +15% political power. Every Transcaucasian state +10 compliance.
focuses.name: The National Committees

focuses.desc:
The economic command takes over every well, refinery and pipeline. The peoples are labour.

Effect: +2 oil in Baku and Grozny. -20000 manpower (labour levies).
focuses.name: Wirtschaftskommando Kaukasus

focuses.desc:
While Moskowien burns and the Ukraine starves, Kaukasien is quiet - not loyal, but quiet. It will not break when the others do.

Effect: +10% stability, +10% war support. Kaukasien never goes through a civil war or a rising.
focuses.name: The Quiet Reichskommissariat

focuses.desc:
The oil engineers who followed the army in 1942 come back to finish the job: capping burning wells and rebuilding what the Soviets blew up.

Effect: +1 synthetic refinery in Baku.
focuses.name: Technische Brigade Mineralol

focuses.desc:
The first Caucasian oil field the Germans reached, and the most thoroughly destroyed.

Effect: +4 oil in Krasnodar (234).
focuses.name: The Maikop Wells

focuses.desc:
Grozny's refineries made aviation spirit for the Red Army. Now for the Luftwaffe.

Effect: +1 synthetic refinery and +4 oil in Chechnya-Ingushetia (821).
focuses.name: The Grozny Refineries

focuses.desc:
The greatest oil city in the world outside America. Its wells were wrecked by the retreating Soviets; rebuilding them is the Reich's biggest project in the East.

Effect: +10 oil in Azerbaijan (229). +1 civilian factory in Baku.
focuses.name: Baku

focuses.desc:
The Reich's oil monopoly for the East takes the concessions - with Goring's men on the board.

Effect: +10% local resources. Germany: +1 civilian factory.
focuses.name: Kontinentale Ol AG

focuses.desc:
Tankers across the Caspian to Astrakhan, and barges up the Volga.

Effect: +1 dockyard and +1 infrastructure in Astrakhan (236).
focuses.name: Caspian Tankers

focuses.desc:
The old Baku-Batumi pipeline is relaid to the Black Sea, where Romanian and German tankers wait.

Effect: +2 infrastructure in Georgia (231) and Azerbaijan (229). Unlocks 'Send Extra Oil to the Reich'.
focuses.name: The Batumi Pipeline

focuses.desc:
Tank farms along the railway from Rostov to Baku.

Effect: +2 fuel silos in Krasnodar and Azerbaijan.
focuses.name: Fuel Depots of the East

focuses.desc:
If the Reichskommissariate ever have to stand alone, they will run on Caucasian oil.

Effect: when the Ostschild forms, every member gets 5000 fuel, and RKK +20% fuel gain for a year.
focuses.name: Oil for the Ostschild

focuses.desc:
The Caucasus pumps more oil than it ever did for Stalin.

Effect: +10% local resources, +1 synthetic refinery in Grozny. Germany: -2% consumer goods while we are its subject.
focuses.name: Black Gold

focuses.desc:
Fifty peoples, forty languages, and every one of them with a grievance against Moscow. Berlin means to use them all - and to rank them.

Effect: unlocks the people branches.
focuses.name: The Peoples of the Caucasus

focuses.desc:
The Cossacks declared themselves 'Aryan Goths' and rode with the Wehrmacht. Berlin promised them a homeland on the Kuban and the Don.

Effect: +10 compliance in the Cossack states (234, 235, 238).
focuses.name: Kosakenland

focuses.desc:
The Kuban Cossack Host is restored with its atamans and its stanitsas.

Available: Krasnodar (234) compliance at least 50%.
Effect: core on Krasnodar (234).
focuses.name: The Kuban Host

focuses.desc:
The Terek Host around Stavropol, the Don Cossacks at Volgodonsk.

Available: Stavropol (235) and Volgodonsk (238) compliance at least 50%.
Effect: cores on Stavropol (235) and Volgodonsk (238).
focuses.name: The Terek and Don Hosts

focuses.desc:
A Field Ataman of all the Hosts, sworn to the Reich.

Effect: +10% recruitable population in cored states. +5% stability.
focuses.name: The Cossack Ataman

focuses.desc:
Buddhist herdsmen who fought the Soviets from the saddle - and were rewarded, for once, by being left alone.

Effect: 2 'Kalmyk Cavalry' divisions (3x2 cavalry, low experience).
focuses.name: The Kalmyk Cavalry Corps

focuses.desc:
Kalmykia gets its own administration under a German advisor.

Available: Kalmykia (237) compliance at least 50%.
Effect: core on Kalmykia (237).
focuses.name: The Kalmyk Steppe

focuses.desc:
In 1942 the Wehrmacht let the Karachays and Kabardins run their own affairs, and the mountains stayed quiet. Schickedanz tries the same.

Effect: +15 compliance in Kabardino-Balkaria (827) and North Ossetia (828). Raids 10 days later for good.
focuses.name: The Mountain Peoples

focuses.desc:
Village councils, the mosques reopened, the collective farms dissolved.

Effect: mountain states +10% compliance growth. Raids 15 days later for good.
focuses.name: Mountain Autonomy

focuses.desc:
Blockhouses on every pass. The mountains are held, not won.

Effect: mountain states -50% resistance growth, -10% compliance growth. Raids 10 days sooner for good.
focuses.name: Garrison the Mountains

focuses.desc:
Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan: old nations with their own churches, alphabets and emigre governments in waiting.

Effect: Transcaucasian states +10 compliance.
focuses.name: Beyond the Range

focuses.desc:
Prince Irakli Bagration in Rome would like a crown. Berlin would like Tiflis quiet.

Effect: +10% stability. Georgia and Abkhazia +15 compliance.
focuses.name: The Georgian Question

focuses.desc:
Turkey watches Azerbaijan; the Armenians watch Turkey. Each gets just enough to fear the other.

Effect: Azerbaijan and Armenia +15 compliance.
focuses.name: Azerbaijan and Armenia

focuses.desc:
City councils, national committees, schools in Georgian, Armenian and Azeri: Kaukasien gives its peoples more than Moskowien ever will. But the Georgians, Armenians and Azerbaijanis hate each other more than they hate Berlin, and the Reichskommissariat can only lean on one of them. Where the capital finally sits decides which.

Effect: unlocks the choice of capital - Tiflis, Yerevan or Baku. Only one.
focuses.name: The Capital Question

focuses.desc:
The capital stays in Tiflis, and the Georgians mean to make it count: Georgian ministers, Georgian officers, a Georgian voice in every committee. They do not want a capital, they want THE capital - and influence over everyone else.

Available: Georgia (231) compliance at least 50%.
Effect: core on Georgia (231). Capital stays in Tiflis. +15% political power. Armenia and Azerbaijan get 'Ethnic Tension' (-15% compliance growth, raids there 50% more likely).
focuses.name: Tiflis, the Seat of Power

focuses.desc:
The Armenians, who have the most to fear from Turkey, are the most loyal - and the Reichskommissariat moves to Yerevan under Mount Ararat. Ankara is not pleased.

Available: Armenia (230) compliance at least 50%.
Effect: capital moves to Yerevan (230), core on Armenia. +10% stability. Turkey -25 opinion. Georgia and Azerbaijan get 'Ethnic Tension'.
focuses.name: The Capital in Yerevan

focuses.desc:
Baku is happy: the capital comes to the oil. The Azerbaijanis get the ministries, Turkey applauds, and the oil men are next door to the Reichskommissar.

Available: Azerbaijan (229) compliance at least 50%.
Effect: capital moves to Baku (229), core on Azerbaijan. +10% local resources. Turkey +25 opinion. Georgia and Armenia get 'Ethnic Tension'.
focuses.name: The Capital in Baku

focuses.desc:
Georgians run the police and the railways from the Black Sea to the Caspian - and the Armenians and Azerbaijanis notice.

Effect: +1 civilian factory in Tiflis. Abkhazia (826) +20 compliance. 'Ethnic Tension' raids 10 days sooner.
focuses.name: The Georgian Ascendancy

focuses.desc:
Armenians from Turkey, Iran and the Soviet camps come home to the capital of the Caucasus.

Effect: +100000 population in Armenia. +1 civilian factory in Yerevan. 2 'Armenian Legion' divisions if the Armenian Legion was raised.
focuses.name: A Refuge for the Armenians

focuses.desc:
The Reichskommissariat governs from the oil city. The wells are guarded like palaces.

Effect: +5 oil and +1 civilian factory in Baku. Raids on Baku do half the damage.
focuses.name: Baku, Capital of Oil

focuses.desc:
The Swabian villages of Helenendorf and Katharinenfeld were deported by Stalin in 1941. Their survivors are brought back, with new settlers from the Reich.

Effect: +1 building slot in every cored state. +5% stability.
focuses.name: The Caucasus Germans

focuses.desc:
The killing unit that followed the army into the Caucasus. In Krasnodar its Sonderkommando used gas vans; it is still at work.

Effect: -15000 manpower. Germany's opinion +10. -5% stability.
focuses.name: Einsatzgruppe D

focuses.desc:
Near Mineralnye Vody in September 1942, some 6,000 Jews from the spa towns of Kislovodsk, Pyatigorsk and Essentuki were shot in an anti-tank ditch. The Mountain Jews of Nalchik were spared only after a 'racial' dispute among the occupiers.

Effect: -10000 manpower. -5% stability. Raids 10 days sooner for good.
focuses.name: Mineralnye Vody

focuses.desc:
No Reichskommissariat has more men willing to fight the Soviets. The Legions are recruited from every people.

Effect: 2 'Caucasian Legion' divisions (3x2 infantry, low experience).
focuses.name: The Ostlegionen

focuses.desc:
Chechens, Ingush, Ossetians, Dagestanis.

Effect: 1 'Caucasian Legion' division. Raids 10 days later for good.
focuses.name: The North Caucasian Legion

focuses.desc:
Georgians who were Soviet prisoners of war and chose the German uniform over the camp.

Effect: 1 'Caucasian Legion' division. Georgia +10 compliance.
focuses.name: The Georgian Legion

focuses.desc:
General Dro's Armenians, who hope a German victory will keep the Turks out.

Effect: 1 'Caucasian Legion' division. Armenia +10 compliance.
focuses.name: The Armenian Legion

focuses.desc:
Von Pannwitz's Cossacks - the best cavalry the Reich still has.

Effect: 2 'Cossack Cavalry' divisions (3x2 cavalry, some experience).
focuses.name: The Cossack Cavalry Corps

focuses.desc:
Training in the high Caucasus, where Edelweiss soldiers once raised the flag on Elbrus.

Effect: +1 research bonus for mountaineers. 1 'Caucasian Mountain Rifles' division (3x2 mountaineers).
focuses.name: Mountain Troops

focuses.desc:
The largest native army of any Reichskommissariat - and the one the Ostschild will lean on if the Reich ever falls silent.

Effect: +10% division attack and defence for Legion and Cossack divisions. +5% war support.
focuses.name: The Army of the Caucasus

focuses.desc:
In the mountains the outlaw - the abrek - is a hero. They raided the Tsar and Stalin; now they raid the oil fields.

Effect: unlocks the Chase the Terrorists decisions against the Caucasian partisans.
focuses.name: The Abreks

focuses.desc:
The Chechen insurgent who fought the Soviets for a decade now fights the Germans with the same rifles.

Effect: a sweep of Chechnya: raids 30 days later, once. Chechnya +10 compliance.
focuses.name: Khasan Israilov

focuses.desc:
Communist cells in the oil workers' districts - and the SME's agents among them.

Effect: raids on oil states do half the damage.
focuses.name: The Baku Underground

focuses.desc:
The Military Georgian Road and the Ossetian Road are guarded every kilometre.

Effect: +1 infrastructure in North Ossetia and Georgia. Raids 10 days later for good.
focuses.name: Blockhouses on the Passes

focuses.desc:
Elders who hand over their abreks are paid in gold and left alone.

Available: completed The Caucasian Federation.
Effect: raids 20 days later for good.
focuses.name: Amnesty for the Clans

focuses.desc:
The partisans cannot be beaten in the mountains - only kept out of the oil fields.

Effect: Chase the Terrorists +25% success. Kaukasien still never has a civil war.
focuses.name: The Mountains Are Never Quiet

focuses.desc:
Kaukasien borders Turkey and Iran: the Reich's frontier with the Middle East.

Effect: +10 opinion with Turkey and Iran.
focuses.name: The Southern Frontier

focuses.desc:
Turkey stayed out of the war and is owed nothing - but a friendly Ankara keeps the Black Sea quiet.

Effect: Turkey +25 opinion. Trade: +1 civilian factory (chromium deal).
focuses.name: Friendship with Ankara

focuses.desc:
The Caspian shore and the Araxes river: British and American oil men watch from Tabriz.

Effect: +1 land fort level on the Azerbaijani border. +5% war support.
focuses.name: The Iranian Border

focuses.desc:
From Tiflis, Berlin can reach Mosul and Tabriz. Schickedanz dreams of a viceroyalty.

Effect: +10% political power. Germany's opinion +15.
focuses.name: Gateway to the Middle East
